name: Dry Cheetah 92
author: Tanvisharma31
description: Dark rounded red button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #1a1a2e to #eb4d4b, box-shadow becomes 0px 15px 20px #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Dry Cheetah 92</title>
<style>
/* Dry Cheetah 92 by Tanvisharma31 — https://uiverse.io/Tanvisharma31/dry-cheetah-92 */
.space-adventure-button {
  background-color: #1a1a2e;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 20px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-radius: 40px;
  box-shadow: 0px 8px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
}

.space-adventure-button:hover {
  background-color: #eb4d4b;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0px 15px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="space-adventure-button">Join the Adventure</button>

</body>
</html>
